metric.semantic_locality.method: Per spec 6.1.3.C, for each frozen probe's measured_fragment, the number of required external semantic lookups or declaration-graph hops (callee signature, variable declaration, type declaration, overload set, trait/interface impl, imported definition, global config/mode) needed to resolve the frozen semantic_facts_expected for that probe was counted. A lookup was counted ONLY when it was necessary to resolve a fact in the fixed inventory (per spec: 'a lookup that is optional for extra detail must not be counted'). Context explicitly included inside a probe's measured_fragment boundary (e.g. F05.P2's put declaration, F14.P1's full enum declaration, F20.P2's whole exported function) required zero external lookups. Context the probe declares as 'given'/'already declared elsewhere' (R5) was counted as one non-local lookup only when a listed semantic fact actually depended on it (e.g. the declared element type of an already-declared Vec, or a callee's signature needed to determine caller-side aliasing/move behavior per F05.P1's own scoring note).

normalization.basis: all-fragments (all 44 fixed probes for Rust; Rust has a supportable fragment, FULL or PARTIAL, for every probe in this universe, so the all-fragments and common-basis figures for Rust are identical pending the other nine languages' fragment sets, which this worker was not assigned).
normalization.caveat: This figure must be recombined by the runner with the other nine languages' identically-derived figures (same L_max=7, same formula, same 44-probe basis) before any cross-language ranking is computed, per the common_basis_rule and basis_reporting_requirement in capability_universe.json.
normalization.formula: score = 100 * (1 - mean(L_i) / L_max), where L_i is the raw lookup count for probe i and L_max = 7 is the fixed number of lookup categories enumerated in semantic_compression.md 6.1.3.C (callee signature, variable declaration, type declaration, overload set, trait/interface implementation, imported definition, global configuration/mode). Lower mean lookup cost yields a higher (better) score, consistent with 'lower lookup cost is better.'

rationale_notes.F02.P2: Rust expresses genuine uninitialized storage via MaybeUninit<[u8;16]>; the guarantee that this is NOT zero/default-filled requires one lookup to the std::mem::MaybeUninit documentation (type declaration / imported definition).
rationale_notes.F03.P1/F03.P2/F04.P2/F07.*/F08.P2/F09.*/: The operand/receiver local (x, xs, a, b, i, d, s1, s2, o) is 'already-declared' context per R5; one lookup to that declaration is required to fix its concrete type/mutability, which the overflow/conversion/equality/index facts in the site list depend on.
rationale_notes.F05.P1: Per the probe's own scoring note this is the required spec-6.1.4.B probe; in Rust the bare call f(x) with a Vec argument either moves x (if f takes Vec<i32> by value) or borrows it (if f takes &Vec<i32>/&mut Vec<i32>); the post-call read of x[0] only type-checks under the borrowing signature, so one lookup to f's declared signature is required to resolve aliasing/mutability/allocation facts. F05.P2's put declaration is inside the measured_fragment for that probe (per its own boundary definition) so it requires zero external lookups.
rationale_notes.F13.P1/F13.P2: Determining that str::parse::<i32>() returns a Result (possible_failure / alternative_value_cases) requires one lookup to the standard library's imported definition/signature for parse.
rationale_notes.F14.P2: Shape's variant declaration is given context from the companion probe F14.P1 rather than being inside F14.P2's own measured_fragment; one lookup is required to confirm exhaustiveness of the match.
rationale_notes.F14.P3: Resolving both the trait's declaration in the shapes unit and the separate unit's Tri impl requires two declaration-graph hops (trait/interface definition + a second unit's impl).
rationale_notes.F15.P2: The declaration-site bound relies on the standard Ord trait; one lookup to that trait's contract is required to know exactly what comparison guarantee is being required.
rationale_notes.F17.P1: Resolving the exact release-on-every-path guarantee of std::fs::File requires one lookup to its documented Drop/RAII contract (imported definition).
rationale_notes.F17.P2: The module-level 'released' counter is given context outside the fragment; one lookup to its declaration is needed to confirm it is the same counter being incremented.
rationale_notes.F18.P1: println! is part of the Rust prelude with no import statement required and its side-effect/failure behavior is fixed by the language itself, so zero lookups were counted.
rationale_notes.F18.P2/F20.P2: Both units/declarations required by the probe are inside the measured_fragment per the probe's own boundary, so zero external lookups were counted.
rationale_notes.F19.P1/F19.P2: std::thread::spawn / std::sync::Mutex+Arc guarantees (join semantics, documented race-freedom of the lock) each require one lookup to the standard library's documented contract.
rationale_notes.F20.P1: extern "C" { fn abs(x: i32) -> i32; } relies on the platform C ABI/linkage convention, one lookup.
